1: // Simple Orbital Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   // background stars with twinkle
5:   const starCount = 120;
6:   const stars = [];
7:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
8:     stars.push({
9:       x: Math.random() * w,
10:       y: Math.random() * h,
11:       baseR: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
12:       r: 0,
13:       a: Math.random(), // alpha
14:       da: (Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1), // flicker speed
15:     });
16:   }
17:   // audio context and helper
18:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
19:   // start sound on first interaction
20:   let audioStarted = false;
21:   function ensureAudio() {
22:     if (!audioStarted && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
23:       audioCtx.resume();
24:     }
25:     audioStarted = true;
26:   }
27:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
28:     ensureAudio();
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.type = 'sine';
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
36:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
37:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now + 0.01);
38:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);
39:     osc.start(now);
40:     osc.stop(now + dur);
41:   }
42:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
43:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
44:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
45:     osc.type = 'sine';
46:     osc.connect(gain);
47:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
48:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
49:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
50:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now + 0.01);
51:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);
52:     osc.start(now);
53:     osc.stop(now + dur);
54:   }
55:   let collisionPlayed = false; // prevent repeat game‑over sound
56:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
57:   const w = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth);
58:   const h = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight);
59:   const center = { x: w / 2, y: h / 2 };
60: 
61:   const planetR = 30;
62:   const shipR = 8;
63:   const orbitR = Math.min(w, h) / 3;
64:   let shipAngle = 0;
65:   const shipSpeed = 0.04; // rad per frame when key held
66:   let left = false,
67:     right = false;
68: 
69:   const asteroids = [];
70:   const asteroidR = 12;
71:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
72:   let lastSpawn = 0;
73:   let startTime = performance.now();
74:   let gameOver = false;
75: 
76:   const keyDown = (e) => {
77:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;
78:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = true;
79:   };
80:   const keyUp = (e) => {
81:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
82:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
83:   };
84:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
85:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
86: 
87:   function spawnAsteroid() {
88:     // choose random edge
89:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
90:     let x, y;
91:     if (side === 0) { x = 0; y = Math.random() * h; }
92:     else if (side === 1) { x = w; y = Math.random() * h; }
93:     else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random() * w; y = 0; }
94:     else { x = Math.random() * w; y = h; }
95:     // direction toward center
96:     const dx = center.x - x;
97:     const dy = center.y - y;
98:     const mag = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
99:     const speed = 1.5;
100:     const vx = (dx / mag) * speed;
101:     const vy = (dy / mag) * speed;
102:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: asteroidR });
103:     // sound for spawn
104:     playTone(200, 0.08);
105:   }
106: 
107:   function update(dt) {
108:     if (left) shipAngle -= shipSpeed;
109:     if (right) shipAngle += shipSpeed;
110:     // update stars (twinkle)
111:     for (let s of stars) {
112:       s.r = s.baseR * (0.5 + 0.5 * s.a);
113:       s.a += s.da;
114:       if (s.a <= 0 || s.a >= 1) s.da = -s.da; // reverse direction
115:     }
116:     // update asteroids
117:     for (let a of asteroids) {
118:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
119:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
120:     }
121:     // collision check
122:     const shipX = center.x + Math.cos(shipAngle) * orbitR;
123:     const shipY = center.y + Math.sin(shipAngle) * orbitR;
124:     for (let a of asteroids) {
125:       const d = Math.hypot(a.x - shipX, a.y - shipY);
126:       if (d < a.r + shipR) {
127:         if (!collisionPlayed) {
128:           playTone(100, 0.3);
129:           collisionPlayed = true;
130:         }
131:         gameOver = true;
132:         break;
133:       }
134:     }
135:   }
136: 
137:   function draw() {
138:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
139:     // dark background
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
141:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
142:     // background stars
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
144:     for (let s of stars) {
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:       ctx.fill();
148:     }
149:     // planet with gradient
150:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(center.x, center.y, planetR * 0.2, center.x, center.y, planetR);
151:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
152:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
153:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, planetR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:     ctx.fill();
157:     // orbit path
158:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
159:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, orbitR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:     ctx.stroke();
163:     // ship as a triangle with gradient and glow
164:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,0,0.6)';
165:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
166:     const shipX = center.x + Math.cos(shipAngle) * orbitR;
167:     const shipY = center.y + Math.sin(shipAngle) * orbitR;
168:     const shipAngleRad = shipAngle;
169:     const tipX = shipX + Math.cos(shipAngleRad) * shipR * 2;
170:     const tipY = shipY + Math.sin(shipAngleRad) * shipR * 2;
171:     const leftX = shipX + Math.cos(shipAngleRad + Math.PI * 0.75) * shipR;
172:     const leftY = shipY + Math.sin(shipAngleRad + Math.PI * 0.75) * shipR;
173:     const rightX = shipX + Math.cos(shipAngleRad - Math.PI * 0.75) * shipR;
174:     const rightY = shipY + Math.sin(shipAngleRad - Math.PI * 0.75) * shipR;
175:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(leftX, leftY, tipX, tipY);
176:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0c0');
177:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
178:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
179:     ctx.beginPath();
180:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
181:     ctx.lineTo(leftX, leftY);
182:     ctx.lineTo(rightX, rightY);
183:     ctx.closePath();
184:     ctx.fill();
185:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset shadow
186:     // asteroids with radial gradient
187:     for (let a of asteroids) {
188:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
189:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7070');
190:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#660000');
191:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
192:       ctx.beginPath();
193:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
194:       ctx.fill();
195:     }
196:     // score
197:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
199:     const secs = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
200:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${secs}s`, 10, 20);
201:     if (gameOver) {
202:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
203:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
204:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
205:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
206:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
207:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
208:     }
209:   }
210: 
211:   function loop(timestamp) {
212:     if (!gameOver) {
213:       const dt = 1; // constant step for simplicity
214:       if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
215:         spawnAsteroid();
216:         lastSpawn = timestamp;
217:       }
218:       update(dt);
219:     }
220:     draw();
221:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
222:   }
223: 
224:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
225: })();
